name: Archdale
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Archdale, NC 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Archdale, North Carolina for 2026: Kersey Valley Christmas lights and train, a park evening and two parades, with prices checked.
lede: Archdale is home to Kersey Valley Christmas, a million lights and a train ride, and adds a park evening and a Main Street parade, with Randleman's parade close by.
celebrates: Kersey Valley Attractions turns its Archdale farm into Kersey Valley Christmas from November 27 to December 23, with more than a million lights, unlimited rides and attractions and a train ride, according to the farm. The City of Archdale hosts Archdale Community Christmas at Creekside Park on December 5, and the Archdale-Trinity SERCO organizes the Archdale Christmas Parade on Main Street on December 6, according to the Randolph County tourism calendar. Randleman, a few miles south, holds its parade and tree lighting on December 3.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Archdale's holiday events, so this page leans on the host pages for 2026. Kersey Valley's own site describes its Christmas season as a long running tradition, and the county calendar lists Archdale's parade each December.
facts: Kersey Valley Christmas is at 6948 Cecil Farm Road in Archdale, with preferred parking at 1616 Kersey Valley Road. Visit High Point lists its train as the Kersey Valley Express. Archdale and Trinity share the SERCO organization that runs the parade, according to the county tourism calendar.
trains: Archdale has a Christmas train at Kersey Valley, where the ride is part of the unlimited attractions in the $25 ticket. For more rail history, the N.C. Transportation Museum at the old Spencer Shops in Spencer lists admission from $10 or $20 with a 25 minute train ride, and it appears on our museum guide.
train_links: The old Spencer Shops with train rides and Christmas train tips, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: More than a million lights, unlimited rides and a train ride from November 27 to December 23.
An evening at Creekside Park on December 5, 4 to 7 pm.
A free Main Street parade on Sunday, December 6, 3 to 6 pm.
A free parade and tree lighting on Thursday, December 3.
kidfact: Archdale's Christmas train rolls through more than a million lights.
faq: Is there a Christmas train in Archdale?

Yes. Kersey Valley Christmas lists a train ride with its unlimited attractions, open November 27 to December 23, 2026. Tickets are $25 for ages 4 and up and $15 for seniors, and ages 3 and under are free.
When is the Archdale Christmas parade?
The Randolph County tourism calendar lists the Archdale Christmas Parade on Sunday, December 6, 2026 from 3 to 6 pm on Main Street. Public parades are free to watch.
Is Kersey Valley Christmas open every night?
No. The farm lists Fridays from 5:30 to 9 pm, Saturdays and Sundays from 4 to 9 pm, and Monday to Wednesday of the final week from 5:30 to 9 pm.
At Creekside Park, 214 Park Drive, Archdale, on Saturday, December 5 from 4 to 7 pm, according to the City of Archdale.
